title: Experimental Features
description: An Mod That Enables Unreleased Features, Which Are Already In The Released Code!
body:
### Features: - Shows You All Experimental Features Which Are Not Enabled By Default In An Simple Menu! - Allows You To Enable / Dissable Unreleased Features For Minecraft And Mods Mentioned Bellow! - Adds Debug Commands To Quickly Test New Features!
Supported Mods Experimental Features Supports: 1. Minecraft 2. [X To Xray](https://modrinth.com/mod/x-to-xray) 3. [F To Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/ftofreecam) ### This Mod Is Opensource! View The Documentation On Github On How To use It With Your Mod!
